rationale: The workflow already applies dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) via `cache: "pnpm"` in setup-node for the unit, node, bun, and deno jobs. The npm job explicitly disables caching with a security comment about poisoned caches, matching the pattern's contraindication for untrusted cached content. Cancel-superseded-runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is already implemented through workflow-level and job-level concurrency with cancel-in-progress. Fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) is contraindicated because the node job is a comprehensive compatibility matrix across Node versions, OSes, and module types where every outcome is required and full failure diagnostics are needed. Custom timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) lack per-job duration history to set a safe limit. No new supported optimization applies without weakening coverage or contradicting existing security intent.
